user.title: Swann NVR
user.description: Connect to a Swann NVR (RaySharp firmware) on your local network.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the NVR.
data_description.port: Port of the NVR web interface.
data_description.verify_ssl: NVRs usually use a self-signed certificate; leave off unless you installed a trusted one.

abort.wrong_device: The credentials belong to a different NVR.

data.manage_servers: Also manage DDNS and cloud upload servers (experimental)

data_description.manage_servers: Lets the Swann cloud switch also turn off DDNS and the Swann/Dropbox/Google Drive/AWS upload servers. Untested: the NVR may clear their saved passwords when these settings are written.

no_saved_cloud_settings.message: No saved cloud settings to restore. Re-enable cloud features in the NVR or Swann app.
